exception.labelLength: The exception label must have 1 to 200 characters.
exception.valueLength: The exception value must have 1 to 2048 characters.
exception.invalidIp: Enter an IP address or a CIDR network; /0 and unspecified addresses are not allowed.
exception.notLocalPath: Use a full local path such as C:\…
exception.unreadable: The .exe file is missing or cannot be read.
exception.duplicate: An equivalent kill-switch exception already exists.
exception.broad: A very broad exception: almost all traffic may bypass the VPN through it.

error.bfeUnavailable: The Base Filtering Engine service (BFE) is unavailable, so protection cannot be applied.
error.wfp: WFP filter error ({{code}}); the previous filters stay in place.
error.persist: The protection settings could not be saved.
error.sessionActive: Disconnect the VPN before repairing the firewall rules: the kill switch cannot be removed safely while the TUN is active.
error.levelUnconfirmed: The protection level change was not confirmed
error.exceptionsUnconfirmed: The exception update and its rollback were not confirmed. Core protection is kept. Check the firewall and try again.

notice.unverified: Protection is not confirmed; traffic may go out directly.

status.firewallOutboundBlock: Windows Firewall blocks outgoing connections by default. If the VPN does not connect, allow the VPN engines in the firewall.
status.hypervUnfiltered: Virtual machines and WSL use their own network: the kill switch does not cover them.
